The main takeaway from our work is that
the immune system can be manipulated in order to induce tolerance to a transplant, and that the immune system is capable of maintaining that tolerance in the long term.
the immune system can be reprogrammed to accept a foreign organ, but that this process takes time, and that the time required is inversely proportional to the degree of mismatch with the recipient.
